count_poisson.purpose: a Poisson target whose variance is its mean, so a constant-variance scorer is mis-weighted where it matters

friedman1.purpose: published bed: a sine interaction and a centred square that no linear statistic can see

friedman2.purpose: published bed whose column ranges differ by orders of magnitude, by design rather than by accident

friedman3.purpose: published bed where a ratio is the entire signal, so neither operand is informative at a fixed marginal

graded_cardinality.purpose: equal signal at four cardinalities: a method ranking them apart is ranking by split opportunities

heavy_tail_t4.purpose: infinite kurtosis: a Pearson statistic is decided by a handful of rows and a rank statistic is not

id_trap.purpose: a unique-per-row column that maximises impurity importance and generalises to nothing

joint_tail_gaussian_control.purpose: same correlation and gate, no tail dependence: isolates a tail failure from a gate failure

joint_tail_t4.purpose: the signal fires only where both columns share a tail, so no linear marginal statistic sees it

latent_replicates_private_delta.purpose: the members are jointly necessary, so collapsing the cluster destroys signal

linear_gaussian_lowdim_n200.purpose: small n: a t-statistic uses every row, a binned MI estimate throws most of them away

linear_k5_p50.purpose: control: every method should succeed here, except the one that never looks at the target

mb_spouse_collider.purpose: a blanket member that is invisible until one conditions on the collider

mediator_chain_with_proxy.purpose: the declared answer key, not the method, decides who wins here

missingness_trio_30pct.purpose: three missingness mechanisms on sibling columns, so one run separates recoverable bias from unrecoverable

multiclass_k3.purpose: each class depends on a different rotation of the weights, so the answer key is the union over classes

null_p100.purpose: false-discovery discipline: nothing is relevant, so anything selected is a false positive

null_p1000.purpose: the same discipline where the best-looking noise column is genuinely convincing

ordinal_k4.purpose: ordered classes on one latent axis, paired with the multiclass bed to separate class structure from class count

outliers_020permille.purpose: fixed-rate contamination rather than a heavy law, which is what a broken sensor actually produces

quantized_6levels.purpose: fewer distinct values than an estimator wants bins, so ties dominate the ranking

rare_class_010permille.purpose: a one-per-cent positive rate reached by intercept shift, so imbalance is not confounded with sample size

redundant_exact_k5.purpose: importance splits across identical copies, so each looks weaker than the direction is

shift_concept.purpose: P(y|x) rotates while P(x) stays put: the half of drift that reweighting cannot fix

shift_covariate.purpose: P(x) moves and P(y|x) does not: paired with the concept-shift bed, which differs in exactly one declaration

tail_isolation_clayton_vs_gaussian.purpose: two pairs at matched rank correlation, one tail-dependent: the only bed here where the copula is the whole difference

weston_guyon_k4_p100.purpose: published bed: equal-weight informative columns against same-marginal probes, so partial credit is unavailable

xor3.purpose: operands with zero marginal association: invisible to any one-column-at-a-time ranking

xor3_plus_marginal_decoy.purpose: separates finding nothing from confidently finding the wrong thing

zero_inflated_40pct.purpose: a point mass equal-mass binning cannot split, so the delivered bin count is silently not the requested one

zipf_levels.purpose: power-law level frequencies: a long tail with almost no rows per level
